title: Sajjad Pay Haey Zulm Ki Wo Inteha Huwee
body:
Ankhon Kay Samnay Hee Bint-e-Nabi Ki Ladlee Haey Bay Rida Huwee
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Nay Tho Sar Kata Liya Maqtal Mei So Gaey
Kufa O Shaam Ub Meri Qismath Mei Ho Gaey
Saaey Mei Patharon Kay Bhaiyya Lo Mere Qatl Ki Ye Ibthada Huwee
<<DIVIDER>>
Bazaar-e-Shaam Nathik-e-Quran Aagaey
Tha Shor Khaas-o-Aam Mei Mehmaan Aagaey
Zahra Ki Baiteeion Kai Hathon Mei Rasiyan Kya Insay Khatha Huwee
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindaan Mei Sehmee Huwee Baithee Hai Sakina
Daikha Hai Isnay Khawab Mei Haey Baap Ka Seena
Soee Nahien Hai Pal Bhi Baba Say Apnay Ujree Aaisee Juda Huwee
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab Ka Sar Sajjad Nay Daikha Khula Huwa
Ashkon Ka Rang Josh Mei Aaker Badal Gaya
Baghee Ki Ye Behenain Hain Thashaheer Phupion Ki Jub Ja Baja Huwee
<<DIVIDER>>
Zanjeer Bhi Wazani Tha Abid Beemar Kay
Zakhmon Say Choor Shaam Mei Sub Pardadaar Thay
Ik Kerbala Hussain Ki Ore Dusri Bazaar Mei Yeh Kerbala Huwee
<<DIVIDER>>
Sadqa Shabeer Ka Hai Islam Bachgaya
Kalma Quran Ambiya Ka Naam Bachgaya
Khoon-e-Hussain Jub Gira Kerbal Ki Thapthi Raith Pay Khaaq-e-Shifa Huwee
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya Rab Mere Kalaam Ko Dard-e-Hussain Day
Aal-e-Nabi Ka Waastha Her Dil Ko Chayn Day
Kerta Raha Jo Reh Kay Akhtar Ki Aaj Momino Puri Dua Huwee
